name: AWS cost report (idle resources)
summary: Find billable idle resources in AWS with a monthly list-price estimate.
description: Read-only report of unattached EBS volumes, unused Elastic IPs, instances stopped for a long time (EBS still billed) and snapshots older than 180 days, plus which resources carry the power schedule tag. Amounts are list-price estimates (USD, no discounts) to prioritise clean-up.

inputs.name: StoppedDaysThreshold
inputs.label: Stopped / deallocated for at least (days)
inputs.help: Instances / VMs powered off for fewer days are not reported.
